stream.meaning: Literal query stream=1 selects the stream only alongside stats=1.

event.meaning: Each NDJSON frame is begin, member, complete or failed.

seat.meaning: Begin frame local identity and stats.

perspective.meaning: Member perspective, or null; begin may include own perspective.

signal.meaning: Failed frame signal: sweep-timeout, backpressure-timeout, probe-task-failed, probe-result-unmatched or serialization-failed.

firstMissingSignal.meaning: Fixed literal outcomes are enumerated; The enum lists fixed top-level refusals; terminal frame signals occur in frame signal, not firstMissingSignal. Peer stats signals may have open form refused-<HTTP status>.
